documented_probe: C-7f8aa502 (write the recovered value with the expected normalization): reference floor is medium; the covering task exercises it at medium. The recovered secret must be persisted so the stripped contents match the expected string exactly (lowercase, no surrounding whitespace), with payloads deliberately carrying surrounding spaces and mixed case, and the verifier byte-checks the deliverable and re-runs the tool on hidden dumps. notes: Multi-stage binary recovery: parse a TLV firmware dump, brute-force a 4-digit PIN validated by embedded CRC32 records (decoy TOKEN/CRC pairs, CRC-before-TOKEN ordering, noise and decoy tags), XOR-decode the payload, and persist the secret with exact normalization plus a faithful record table. Hidden dumps vary PIN, token, decoys, noise, and record order. Rubric nonzero for dependent_stages and reasoning_depth (recovery chain), debugging_ambiguity (CRC-validated PIN search), adversarial_inputs (decoy pairs, whitespace-padded payloads), hidden_case_generalization (3 hidden dumps), quantitative_correctness (exact normalization and record table). No tool breadth, no environment pressure; totals bucket to medium.
